content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

School uniforms should not be worn in our schools. They do offer the benefit that the competition over brand-name clothes and the discrimination of the socially weak are prevented. Nevertheless hardly anyone wishes to dress themselves or their children in a standard uniform. Plus such uniforms also stand for ideological conformity and for the suppression of individual self-development.
What is the relation between "Plus such uniforms also stand for ideological conformity and for the suppression of individual self-development." and "School uniforms should not be worn in our schools." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
